entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hi, I'm calling about an order I received recently. I think I need to return something.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Isaac. I can certainly help you with that. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF886-01-B. I'm calling about the helmet I ordered.

Great, thank you. Let me pull that up... VF886-01-B. I see the Aero Race Helmet, delivered on December 24th. That was 13 days ago. To make sure I get you to the right place, could I ask, is it a technical fault with the item or more of a preference?
It's a preference issue. The product is fine, but the color is much brighter in person than it looked on the website. The box is still unopened, I haven't even touched it.
I understand completely. Sometimes screen resolutions can alter the appearance of a color. Let me just confirm the return eligibility for you... One moment.

Okay, thanks for your patience. I've confirmed that this helmet is a standard item and falls within our 90-day return policy. So, yes, I can absolutely process this return for you immediately for a full refund.

That's great news. Thank you, Isaac. Now, since I'm going through the hassle of shipping this back and will be ordering the correct color right after, would it be possible to get a small discount code for my next purchase to offset the inconvenience?

I can definitely appreciate you asking. I've just processed the return authorization and the pre-paid shipping label is on its way to your email now. Regarding a discount, our policy doesn't allow for goodwill credits on preference-based returns. The good news is you will be receiving a full refund once the item is back at our warehouse, which you can then apply to your new order.
Alright, I understand. It was worth a shot. The main thing is getting the right gear. Safety is obviously the top priority, and I want a helmet I'll actually wear.
I couldn't agree more. We want to make sure you have the gear you feel best in. The return label is sent. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you for making it easy.
You are very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
